description: Illustrative Phase-0 baseline manifest (example only). It is intentionally NOT a runnable baseline: required_checkpoint_path is a placeholder, one required entry points at a path that may not exist, and every command is disabled. scripts/run_baseline.py must refuse this manifest and write a record stating measurements were not run.

commands.name: decode-latency-measurement
commands.note: Disabled placeholder. When re-enabled, argv must point at a real local script and checkpoint; the runner records argv, exit code, duration, and bounded output tail only, and never derives performance claims.

commands.name: checkpoint-structural-inspection
commands.note: Disabled placeholder. Structural inspection is safe to run standalone via scripts/inspect_checkpoint.py once a real checkpoint directory exists.
